lines.say: Welcome to Class 24. Month 2 Revision and Evaluation Test.
In Month 2 you learned to travel, ask for directions and shop in Egypt.
You learned to order food, and to compare places and prices.
You learned to report problems, describe symptoms and use the phone.
You learned to make plans, tell stories and talk about your experiences.
Rule one. Revision checklist: everything the student must be able to do by the end of Month 2.
